question: With which country did India conduct a joint military exercise called 'Cyclone-III' at Mahajan Field Firing Range in Rajasthan in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Egypt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Cyclone-III** was a joint military exercise conducted between India and Egypt in February 2025.
 
• The exercise took place at the **Mahajan Field Firing Range** in Rajasthan, showcasing the military collaboration between the two nations.
 
• This exercise focused on enhancing interoperability and operational capabilities in counter-terrorism operations.
 
• India and Egypt signed a strategic partnership agreement in January 2023, which emphasizes cooperation in defense and security.
 
• Egypt has been strengthening bilateral ties with India, including participation in India's Republic Day celebrations as the Chief Guest in 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India-Egypt Relations:** The two countries share strong cultural and historical ties dating back to ancient civilizations, with cooperation in trade, defense, and diplomacy.
 
• **Defense Cooperation:** India and Egypt have conducted joint military exercises, exchanged military delegations, and engaged in defense technology collaboration.
 
• **Mahajan Field Firing Range:** Located in Rajasthan, it is one of the largest military training areas in India, used for various military exercises and training programs.
 
• **Counter-Terrorism Operations:** Joint exercises like Cyclone-III focus on building capabilities in combating terrorism and addressing asymmetric warfare scenarios.
 
• **Strategic Partnership:** The India-Egypt strategic partnership emphasizes areas such as trade, defense, renewable energy, and counter-terrorism cooperation.
